interfaceLanguageDesc: Language used for the app interface
defaultTargetLanguageDesc: The language new entries start in. Pick one of the languages you are learning.
immersionLevelDesc: How much of your own language you want while you practise. This is not how good you are.
immersion0Desc: Starting out. You want your own language next to everything so you can map form to meaning.
immersion1Desc: You can read feedback in the language you are learning, and you want your own language as a safety net.
immersion2Desc: You want the language you are learning by default, with a quick check in your own.
immersion3Desc: You want to think in the language you are learning. Your own language is only a rescue.
languagesYouStudyDesc: Each language has its own immersion level and proficiency. New entries offer only these languages.
proficiencyDesc: How far along you are (A1–C2). Separate from immersion.
proficiencyB1: B1 — I can get through a conversation
proficiencyB2: B2 — I can explain myself clearly
explanationModeDesc: A choice here overrides the immersion level's note language. Follow my immersion level to let the level decide.
errorSavingSettings: Error saving settings. Please try again.
explainInDesc: Your own language. Notes and meaning translations are written in it. Pick the language you are learning for full immersion.
removeLanguageHint: Removing a language keeps its entries. Add it again any time to pick up where you left off.
fullImmersionDesc: You learn {language} with explanations in {language}, so there is nothing to translate: everything stays in {language}.
